findings.claim: The dong/khai distinction fixes the previous self-reference and missing shard-dimension examples, but does not close this cause class. The frozen representation and predicates still fail to cover required failure inputs consistently. (1) Missing, null or wrongly typed selected sha256_test/sha256_tool become null. Rule M requires equality to the checkout hashes, but M_BAM explicitly ignores null and the pinned legacy hop_le predicate accepts all six variants. Emitting M_BAM violates validator self-consistency; omitting it violates M. (2) When artifact REST metadata is unavailable, mandatory artifact ids cannot be supplied for otherwise downloaded predecessor stamps. Null dau_job then forces B_VANG/do for completed jobs, contradicting acceptance 4's core-REST-failure => khong_ket_luan. (3) When REST lists the current producer but its download is unavailable, retaining Manh.artifact requires an unmeasurable non-null content hash; nulling it while preserving the mandatory producer history forces A_TRON, although the latest-attempt artifact exists. Absence of evidence and proven absence/mismatch remain conflated.

evidence.observed_result: Actual current-master _loi_mot_bien_nhan returned [] for correct, wrong valid hash, missing, null and wrong-type values of each of sha256_test and sha256_tool. Literal evaluation of r4 M_BAM detected the two wrong-valid-hash controls, but none of the six missing/null/wrong-type variants; MANH_HONG was also false. This is current-helper execution plus an explicitly labelled SPEC deduction, not execution of an unimplemented collector.

The core-artifact-REST-unavailable countermodel generated R_KHONG_DOC(artifacts) plus B_VANG for rows lacking mandatory artifact ids; the frozen reduction is do, whereas acceptance 4 requires khong_ket_luan. The download-failure representation analysis records the non-null hash/A_TRON dilemma. These are SPEC countermodels, not native GitHub failure runs.

Whole-class scan covered every dong predicate and the Job/Manh absent-evidence shapes. P_THIEU now has an independent root reference and C_CHE_DO now has both raw dimensions; those old manifestations are closed. The remaining witnesses concern both hash fields and both metadata-versus-payload availability boundaries.

findings.suggested_fix: Complete the mapping from source availability/validity to serialized fields, diagnostic predicates and conclusion before freezing v1. Distinguish unobservable metadata, known-absent producer, unreadable payload and measured mismatch; make hashes nullable where genuinely unavailable and specify the corresponding non-green code. When a selected payload exists and expected hashes are known, missing/invalid hashes must trigger a defined diagnostic. Align B_VANG/A_TRON with those availability states instead of inferring proven absence from a null object alone. Add producer-to-validator round trips for each hash field's missing/null/wrong-type variants, each core endpoint failure, and REST-present/download-missing, with healthy and genuine missing-attempt controls. Give each check its own target-exception mutant, including null-skipping and unknown-to-red mutations. This may change the closed schema/fixture and B2/B3 bindings; revise those dependencies explicitly. B1-04 has now recurred in four rounds: the design checkpoint has produced progress, not closure.

findings.claim: The revised equivalence domain only constrains attempt numbers; it still omits the legacy selector's container/namespace validation. Eight readable, legacy-valid expected receipts can all match their latest REST attempt while an additional out-of-range artifact directory makes chon_bien_nhan_du return errors and an empty set. Under the new REST selection and per-receipt hop_le definitions, the eight expected producers remain selected and valid; the unrelated artifact is a separate X diagnostic. Thus section 3(b)'s biconditional still conflicts with those definitions. Extra members inside a selected artifact and unexpected non-directory entries expose the same omitted legacy-envelope precondition. The executor must guess whether to discard diagnostic rows, silently widen hop_le, or narrow the promised equivalence.

evidence.observed_result: Healthy control: actual chon_bien_nhan_du selected 8/8 with no errors. Adding dot-bien-manh-123-1-8 produced a namespace error and selected_count=0; an unexpected non-directory entry also produced 0. Adding extra.txt beside manh-0.json produced the legacy exact-one-file error and selected_count=0. In all three fixtures the eight expected raw receipts individually returned [] from _loi_mot_bien_nhan, and latest REST attempts and highest expected artifact attempts were all 1. The new-side selection is a deduction from SPEC 114, not a B1 implementation result.

Whole-class scan separates the legacy per-receipt predicate from its directory/name/member checks and global empty-on-error return. R4 repairs the newer-REST-attempt and deliberate new hash/key rejection examples, but the new domain does not exclude these structural failures.

findings.suggested_fix: Define the comparison stage and complete legacy input domain explicitly, including artifact namespace, directory/member shape and readability, while retaining diagnostic rows on invalid inputs. Alternatively compare the old selector's final accept/reject result separately from the diagnostic selection, without asserting universal selection equality on malformed containers. Keep the old CLI and aggregator unchanged. Extend the paired A/B matrix with extra-artifact, extra-member and non-directory cases, healthy controls and dedicated mutants for each domain condition; distinguish old-envelope rejection from intentional new B1 rejection. The fix must not suppress X diagnostics or reinstate all-input equivalence.
